question: Does one genuinely non-scalar source/landing endpoint doublet break the width-three Gram obstruction that is invisible to every scalar block-count mark tested through e7e6c80?

scope.ordinary_module: V_3 is the five-dimensional rational span of circular noncrossing connectivities
scope.mark_module: L is the two-dimensional zero-sum quotient of the three landing positions
scope.stop_rule: Compute width three only. If its final intersection is empty, stop and do not construct width four.

source_landing_semantics.landing_positions: lambda_i labels the landing registry whose complementary pair is the two boundary sites other than source site i
source_landing_semantics.provenance: This is the minimal rational C3 source/landing doublet already implicit in the repository's landing-registry observables; it is not a freely selected two-column mark basis.

generic_Q_action.mark_emission: E_i(pi)=q_i if site i is singleton in pi, otherwise zero
generic_Q_action.marked_detach: D_bar_i(Q) has ordinary block D_i(Q), landing block I_2, zero landing-to-ordinary block and ordinary-to-landing block (Q-1)E_i
generic_Q_action.first_jet: D_bar_i1 has P_i in the ordinary block and q_i times the singleton covector in the landing-by-ordinary block

gram.landing_reference_states: tau_i is the width-three connectivity with site i singleton and the other two sites joined
gram.raw_columns: g_i(Q)_pi=d/dQ G(Q)_(pi,tau_i)=b(pi vee tau_i) Q^{b(pi vee tau_i)-1}
gram.compatibility: For radical basis B require B^T(G_bar1 X0-X0^T G_bar1)B=0
gram.non_scalar_gate: Require the two landing columns at Q=1 to have nonzero projection outside the span of ordinary scalar block-count columns used by e7e6c80.

normalization.filtration: The landing subspace is invariant: X0 and V do not feed L back into V_3.
normalization.endpoint: U=(one^T,0,0) is fixed by X0 and annihilates V.
normalization.ordinary_source: X0 fixes the all-singleton ordinary source and V kills it.
normalization.source_landing_transport: On L, X0 is exactly R and V is zero. This is source-to-next-landing transport, not pointwise fixation of two non-invariant mark basis vectors.

affine_jet.order_zero: X0 A_i0=B_i0 X0 for joins, translation and detach, with target site shifted by one

analysis_ladder: plus endpoint normalization and radical invariance
plus ordinary-source and source/landing transport normalization

decision_rule.doublet_breaks_obstruction_unique: The final affine system is consistent with tangent dimension zero.
decision_rule.doublet_breaks_obstruction_nonunique: The final affine system is consistent with positive tangent dimension.
decision_rule.doublet_fails: The final affine system is inconsistent.
decision_rule.success_followup: Only if width three succeeds, freeze a separate width-four typed construction before computing it.
decision_rule.failure_bound: If width three fails, one source/landing doublet is insufficient; the typed-family lower bound becomes at least two non-scalar doublets (mark dimension at least four).

outputs.dimensions: Exact affine tangent dimension or inconsistency at every stage
outputs.non_scalar_certificate: Rank/projection certificate that C is not in the frozen scalar falling-factorial mark span
outputs.obstruction: Exact first-empty left-null witness and whether the landing moduli have nonzero coefficient rank against the old y^T b obstruction
outputs.canonical: Whether X0=T_bar,V=0 belongs to the final intersection and whether velocity is unique

deduplication.e7e6c80: exhausts the width-four scalar falling-factorial family and leaves the width-three scalar Gram obstruction untouched
deduplication.081a5ed: already excludes one scalar terminal response mark
deduplication.ba3135e: already excludes unmarked scalar loop fugacity
deduplication.PR385_b5c761a: is finite-noise identifiability, not this exact landing doublet
deduplication.PR393_8923acd: is a formal Gaussian semigroup and supplies no source/landing representation

claim_boundary: Exact rational Q=1 first-jet algebra at width three only.
The mark is the fixed C3 source/landing doublet; no arbitrary two-column extension is searched.
No continuum LCFT, physical transfer matrix or formal Gaussian-K identification is made.
A width-three failure stops this line and raises only the typed-family mark-dimension lower bound.
